about: Expectations of the M3 security modes (vm/RIG.md section 14, scorer vm/truth/m3-sec-score.ps1). The m3-broker case list is also the list vm/rig-m3.ps1 runs, in this order.

cases.threat: control: the installed layout starts elevated and serves its own Purge.exe; a second client finds the one instance busy (3.3 step 2)
control: an admin-only copy on the system volume starts, so each variant below fails for its one change

reason_all: the parent is not as claimed
the parent is not as claimed

cases.threat: T5 a medium process created the pipe first and serves it; the client's server check refuses it

reason_all: client image is not Purge.exe in the install directory
cases.threat: T2 a copy of Purge.exe elsewhere

reason_all: client pid is not the parent
cases.threat: T2 a second client (another instance of the installed Purge.exe)

reason_all: can be written by a non-administrator
cases.threat: T6 / G10 a user-writable copy with a planted DLL
G10 / BL-R1 S4 a copy off the system volume
3.4 no reparse point on the path

reason_all: purge-broker.exe: a non-administrator can write it
kb: it or an ancestor can be written by a non-administrator
Purge.exe: a non-administrator can write it
can be written by a non-administrator

cases.threat: T7 / G10 ProgramData, ALLUSERSPROFILE, PURGE_KB_DIR, SystemDrive set to a planted tree in the caller's environment
T7 the same values in HKCU\Environment

excluded.why: the pipe itself failing while the broker waits for or reads a client (LinkError::Failed) cannot be caused from outside the broker; a client closing is PipeLost (exit 0). Covered by the serve and pipe tests of xtask ci.

toolkit._: Only a -ConsentUi toolkit run. Probes (review S-B, S-C): SetProp and RemoveProp of each of probe_props, WM_GETOBJECT, and for each of winit_messages (every id winit 0.30.13 registers, src/platform_impl/windows/event_loop.rs) 1 to the dialog's thread and a post and a send to each of probe_windows; the scorer derives the names and the count from these lists, and wants every probe failed with probe_lasterror (ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED), the three windows alive after, and the control from high passing before and after. Times count from the end of the list on screen (arm) or the dialog found (enter), and from the kill.
toolkit._long: Review S-D: the kinds whose list does not fit in a toolkit run (fixture lookalike45): their arming rule must have had to scroll, and three more rules run on them: unseen (up over unseen_min_ms, the end not seen: a real click on the button and on the box do nothing), tabspace (Tab, Space: Cancel), tabearly (End, then Tab, Space, Tab inside tab_early_max_ms: the keyboard not on the button, Enter cancels).
